name: Advanced Order Status For WooCommerce – Custom Status Management & Workflow Automation
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
Advanced Order Status for WooCommerce by VerseSofts is the ultimate solution to optimize your specific store’s fulfillment process. Create, edit, and manage custom order statuses that fit your unique business workflow instead of relying solely on default WooCommerce options.

By utilizing our intuitive interface, you can effortlessly add color-coded labels, assign distinct Dashicons, and utilize bulk actions to significantly increase your team’s order management efficiency.

Whether you need explicit statuses like “Awaiting Payment Proof”, “Packed”, “Ready for Pickup”, or “Shipped (Carrier)”, this plugin hands you the control to track, filter, and organize your orders with complete clarity.

Key Features

  • Unlimited Custom Statuses: Create as many tailored order statuses as your exact workflow requires.
  • Visual Customization: Assign distinct colors and intuitive icons (Dashicons) to every status label for immediate visual identification.
  • Bulk Actions Support: Update order statuses rapidly directly from the WooCommerce orders screen using standard bulk actions.
  • HPOS Compatible: Certified to support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage for maximum database speed and reliability.
  • Email Triggers: Integrates flawlessly with WooCommerce emails to keep customers automatically informed upon status changes.
  • Native UX Integration: Simple, lightweight, and natural UI that looks like it belongs perfectly inside your WooCommerce dashboard.

Perfect For

  • Dropshippers: Track items ordered from suppliers vs. shipped.
  • Manufacturers: Monitor items in assembly, quality check, or packing.
  • B2B / Wholesale: Track approvals, credit checks, or net-30 payment statuses.
  • Local Pickup Stores: Distinguish between “Preparing” and “Ready for Pickup”.

Why Use Custom Order Statuses?

The default WooCommerce statuses often don’t provide enough granularity for modern, complex eCommerce operations. By introducing customizable WooCommerce order statuses, you can:
1. Provide clearer visibility across your entire fulfillment team.
2. Reduce customer support inquiries by offering specific and descriptive order timeline updates.
3. Automate your internal workflows confidently based on exact order stages.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Advanced Order Status for WooCommerce.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Order Statuses to start creating your new workflow steps.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the unzipped advanced-order-status-for-woocommerce folder directly to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Order Statuses.
sections.faq:
Can I edit existing core WooCommerce order statuses?

No, this plugin focuses purely on securely adding new custom statuses. Default WooCommerce statuses remain unchanged to guarantee core platform compatibility and stability.

Will my custom statuses work with WooCommerce email notifications?

Yes! You can trigger standard or custom emails effortlessly when an order transitions into your new, custom status.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your custom statuses will revert to fallback WooCommerce statuses visually, but data is preserved in the database. Re-activating will instantly restore your visual workflow.

Where can I get support?

We offer dedicated support!
* Website: VerseSofts.com
* Documentation: Knowledge Base
* Email Support: contact@versesofts.com
